seo.title: Download TablePro
seo.description: Download TablePro for Apple silicon and Intel Macs, or install it with Homebrew. The iPhone and iPad app is on the App Store.

header.title: Download TablePro
header.lead: Choose a build for your device.

homebrew.title: Homebrew
homebrew.trails: Homebrew’s copy is updated separately and can trail a new release. If it installs an older version, choose <ui>TablePro > Check for Updates…</ui> to get the current one.

mac.signing: TablePro is signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple, so you don’t need to change any security setting to open it.

updates.title: Updates
updates.mac: TablePro checks for updates once a day. A new version downloads in the background and installs the next time you quit the app.

otherPlatforms.body: TablePro is not available for {platforms}, and there is no release date.
